name: TRUMPET
source: Three years have passed since Shinima Junjou committed suicide. During this time, he has been wandering around without a purpose, unable to fully cross over to the other side. But, a chance encounter changed Junjou's entire opinion of his situation. What was once "a second at life" quickly became a quest to find the reason behind his inability to disappear.
translation: Three years have passed since Shinima Junjou committed suicide. During this time, he has been wandering around without a purpose, unable to fully cross over to the other side. But, a chance encounter changed Junjou's entire opinion of his situation. What was once "a second at life" quickly became a quest to find the reason behind his inability to disappear.
